case_description: Tests blocking of a request to the link-local cloud metadata address when the host is written with a trailing dot. URL parsers that follow the URL Standard drop the empty final label and connect to the same address, so a control that compares the host as written never matches it.
source: WHATWG URL Standard, IPv4 parser (a trailing empty part is removed); RFC 1034 section 3.1 (absolute domain names end in the root label)
